_comment: Skeleton: all 71 collection-log pets from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pet with names, categories and item ids (each item id checked against net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID in runelite-api 1.12.39). Every rate is null and unverified except where a sources URL is given. Do not populate a rate without also populating its sources array. See docs/DATA.md.

sources.label: Abyssal Sire
sources.notes: 1/100 unsired per kill times 5/128 per unsired at the Font of Consumption. Assumes every unsired was offered at the Font.

sources.label: Royal Titans (loot)
sources.notes: The collection log keeps one total for all variants, so it is attached here, the rarest variant. Evaluating every attempt at the rarest rate can only understate dryness, and the other variants stay uncounted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: Royal Titans (sacrifice)
sources.notes: Sacrificing gives up loot rolls and doubles the pet chance.

sources.label: Callisto
sources.countWarning: In groups, the pet only rolls for players who receive a drop, which depends on contribution. Kills without a drop are still in the kill count, so group kills make this overstate dryness.

sources.label: Doom of Mokhaiotl (delve level 8)
sources.notes: The collection log's deep delves count is kills at delve level 8 or deeper, so it is attached here, the rarest of those levels. Evaluating every deep delve at 1/500 can only understate dryness; delve levels 6 and 7 are not counted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: Doom of Mokhaiotl (delve level 9+)
sources.notes: The wiki lists no pet chance below delve level 6.

sources.label: The Hueycoatl
sources.countWarning: The pet chance is scaled by your personal contribution. In group kills your real chance was below the base rate, so group kills make this overstate dryness.

sources.label: Infernal cape sacrifice
sources.notes: Gambling an infernal cape makes the same roll as a completion.

sources.label: Inferno completions
sources.notes: The collection log keeps one total for all variants, so it is attached here, the rarest variant. Evaluating every attempt at the rarest rate can only understate dryness, and the other variants stay uncounted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: Inferno completions on a TzKal-Zuk Slayer task
Theatre of Blood (normal mode)
sources.notes: The rate depends on your own performance in each raid, from 1/650 at best to 1/6,500. Completion count alone cannot show how dry you are, so no estimate is made yet.

sources.label: Theatre of Blood (hard mode)
sources.notes: Hard mode has its own base rate, and performance in each raid changes it. Completion count alone cannot show how dry you are, so no estimate is made yet.

sources.label: The Nightmare (5+ players)
sources.notes: The collection log keeps one total for all variants, so it is attached here, the rarest variant. Evaluating every attempt at the rarest rate can only understate dryness, and the other variants stay uncounted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: The Nightmare (solo)
sources.notes: Rate depends on the number of players in the room when the fight started.

sources.label: Araxxor (destroy)
sources.notes: Destroying the corpse gives up loot rolls and doubles the pet chance.

sources.label: Araxxor (harvest)
sources.notes: The collection log keeps one total for all variants, so it is attached here, the rarest variant. Evaluating every attempt at the rarest rate can only understate dryness, and the other variants stay uncounted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: Chambers of Xeric unique drops
sources.notes: Rolled only for the player who receives a unique (purple). The collection log only counts completions, so enter how many uniques you have received to get an estimate.

sources.label: Wintertodt reward cart
sources.countWarning: Rewards claimed matches pet rolls since the Wintertodt rework. Rewards from before the rework may not correspond to rolls one for one; for older history the Wintertodt kill count is closer to the real number of rolls.
sources.notes: The wiki notes the 200m Firemaking XP multiplier applies to this pet; the rate model cannot express that yet.

sources.label: Scorpia
sources.notes: 1/128 rarer than the intended 1/2,000 because of the pre-rolled malediction and odium shard table.

sources.label: Scurrius
sources.countWarning: Only the player who deals the most damage rolls the pet, so the Scurrius kill count cannot be used: it includes group kills where you were not the top damage dealer.

sources.label: Zalcano
sources.countWarning: Only players who contributed enough to the fight roll the pet. Kills below that are still in the kill count, so they make this overstate dryness.

sources.label: Dizana's quiver sacrifice
sources.notes: Gambling a Dizana's quiver makes the same roll as a kill.

sources.label: Tempoross reward pool
sources.notes: One roll on the reward pool per reward permit claimed.

sources.label: Tombs of Amascut
sources.notes: The rate depends on reward points and raid level in each raid, and entry mode rolls at a much lower rate. Completion count alone cannot show how dry you are, so no estimate is made yet.

sources.label: TzHaar Fight Cave completions
sources.notes: The collection log keeps one total for all variants, so it is attached here, the rarest variant. Evaluating every attempt at the rarest rate can only understate dryness, and the other variants stay uncounted, so the figure is shown as an upper bound.

sources.label: TzHaar Fight Cave completions on a TzTok-Jad Slayer task
Fire cape sacrifice
sources.notes: Gambling a fire cape makes the same roll as a completion.

sources.label: Venenatis

sources.label: Vet'ion
sources.countWarning: In groups, the pet only rolls for players who receive a drop, which depends on contribution. Kills without a drop are still in the kill count, so group kills make this overstate dryness.

sources.label: Yama
sources.countWarning: The rate only applies with more than 15% contribution. Kills below that are still in the kill count, so they make this overstate dryness.

sources.label: Grey chinchompas
sources.notes: Base chance verified. XP per action is not confirmed on a second wiki page yet, so no estimate is made from this method.

sources.label: Fishing Trawler
sources.notes: Per successful trip, scaling with contribution from 1/5000 at minimum to 1/2500 at maximum. Not derivable from client state, so this source is UNKNOWN unless the player enters a trip count. At most 12 games per hour is possible.

sources.label: Minnows
sources.notes: Static per-catch rate. The level formula does NOT apply here. Good regression test for the math layer: level changes must not move this number.

methods.notes: Fishing XP per fish caught; barbarian fishing also gives Strength and Agility XP.
Fishing XP per fish caught; barbarian fishing also gives Strength and Agility XP.
Fishing XP per fish caught; barbarian fishing also gives Strength and Agility XP.

sources.label: Runecraft
sources.notes: Placeholder for the per-rune base chance table.

sources.label: Crashed stars
sources.notes: The same base chance at every star size. XP per stardust varies by size, so no estimate is made from this method yet.

sources.label: Volcanic Mine (ore fragments)
sources.notes: Rolled when ore fragments are received. Base chance verified. XP per action is not confirmed on a second wiki page yet, so no estimate is made from this method.

sources.label: Pickpocketing elves
sources.notes: Base chance verified. XP per action is not confirmed on a second wiki page yet, so no estimate is made from this method.

sources.label: Pickpocketing Vyres
sources.notes: Base chance verified. XP per action is not confirmed on a second wiki page yet, so no estimate is made from this method.

sources.label: Sailing
sources.notes: Placeholder for the per-activity base chance table.

sources.label: Farming
sources.notes: Placeholder for the per-crop table. Rolls on check-health or final harvest depending on the patch.

sources.label: Guardians of the Rift reward searches
sources.notes: One roll per search of the Rewards Guardian.

sources.label: Chompy birds
sources.notes: Requires the elite Western Provinces Diary. The count updates when you use Check kills on an ogre bow.

sources.label: Herbiboar harvests
sources.notes: Rolled when harvesting the herbiboar. The count comes from the harvest count message shown after each harvest, so it appears after your next harvest.

sources.label: Soul Wars spoils of war
sources.notes: One roll per spoils of war opened.

sources.label: Hunters' loot sacks (expert and master rumours)
sources.countWarning: Rumours completed also counts novice and adept rumours, whose loot sacks cannot roll Quetzin, and the roll only happens when a sack is opened. Both make this overstate dryness.
sources.notes: The wiki notes the 200m Hunter XP multiplier applies to this pet; the rate model cannot express that yet.

sources.label: Wyrmscraig goats
sources.notes: The wiki gives a 1/(B - level*25) formula for this pet. Base chance not yet entered.
